about_the_game:
Nightmare Escape is a single-player, story-rich visual novel about memory loops and unreliable truths. As Chu-Ling, you relive the same night, gather clues, and choose how to confront the people who may be rewriting your past. Decisions branch the narrative toward multiple endings, including a True End.

Gameplay
Investigate scenes, compare testimonies, and flag contradictions in a lightweight clue log. Pivotal choices reshape relationships and unlock new routes on subsequent runs. After your first clear, convenience features speed up replays for deeper exploration.

Core Features

  • Full main story: Start → Chapters 1–8

  • Choice-driven routes & multiple endings (True End included)

  • Clue Log & Timeline to track evidence and uncertainties

  • Text History, Auto/Manual Saves, Fast-Skip, Chapter Jump

  • Gallery/CG unlocks and small secrets across runs

  • Offline single-player; Simplified Chinese UI/Text

  • Optional: Steam Achievements (if enabled)

What’s Included with Purchase
The complete single-player game, eight-chapter main route with branching endings, gallery and replay conveniences, and ongoing stability/UX updates. No online or multiplayer features.

Content Note
Contains tense scenes and mild injury depictions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or GeForce GT 730 / Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Minimum resolution 1280×720; keyboard and mouse.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 / Radeon R7 370 / Intel UHD 620 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p recommended; SSD recommended.
